content:
Net vertical displacement:
North moves: \(1,5,9,\ldots,41\) (11 terms), sum \(=\frac{11(1+41)}2=231\).
South moves: \(3,7,\ldots,39\) (10 terms), sum \(=\frac{10(3+39)}2=210\).
Net vertical \(=231-210=21\).

Net horizontal displacement:
East moves: \(2,6,\ldots,38\) (10 terms), sum \(=200\).
West moves: \(4,8,\ldots,40\) (10 terms), sum \(=220\).
Net horizontal \(=200-220=-20\).

Distance:
\[
\sqrt{21^2+(-20)^2}=\sqrt{441+400}=\sqrt{841}=29.
\]

\[
\boxed{29}
\]
